title: PoE2 0.2.0c: Minion Scaling, Spear Skills and Boss Corrections
summary: 0.2.0c rolled back part of 0.2.0's over-nerf to minions, adjusted Skeletal Arsonist and Cleric, corrected several spear skills and bosses, and is the patch most Day-1 minion builds needed to wait for.
description: 0.2.0c explained: minion damage and life scaling per gem level, Skeletal Arsonist/Cleric, spear skill corrections, boss fixes and what still applies in 0.5.4e.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: A summoned minion fighting alongside the player.

currentSummary: The 0.2.0c minion scaling curve was a correction; minion balance moved again in 0.3 to 0.5.
Skeletal Arsonist and Cleric were adjusted in 0.2.0c and retuned by later patches.

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: 0.2.0 shipped with minion life and damage scaling that proved far too weak in the mid-campaign, making minion builds feel unplayable on bosses. 0.2.0c corrected that with per-gem-level adjustments to minion damage and life.

It also adjusted Skeletal Arsonist and Skeletal Cleric together, corrected several spear skills that affected Huntress levelling, and fixed a set of bosses. Day-1 0.2.0 minion builds should not be used as-is; this patch is the first point where they became viable again.
bullets: Minion scaling corrected per gem level
Day-1 minion builds need this patch

sections.title: Historical warning
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — the 0.2.0 era
paragraphs: 0.2.0c is a correction patch inside the Dawn of the Hunt launch window. Minion numbers it set were themselves later overwritten by 0.3 to 0.5 rebalances.
bullets: 其召唤数值后来被 0.3–0.5 覆盖

changes.title: Minion damage scaling
changes.detail: Per-gem-level damage adjustments reversed part of the 0.2.0 over-nerf so mid-campaign minions kept pace.

changes.title: Minion life scaling
changes.detail: Early-campaign minion life was restored and converged gradually at high gem levels.

changes.title: Skeletal Arsonist / Cleric
changes.detail: Both archetypes were tuned together to keep their synergy intact after the scaling change.

changes.title: Spear skill corrections
changes.detail: Several spear skills that affected Huntress levelling were corrected.

changes.title: Boss fixes
changes.detail: A set of boss behaviours were corrected in the same patch.

bosses.name: Campaign bosses affected by 0.2.0c
bosses.detail: Several boss behaviours were corrected so they no longer punished minion and spear playstyles unfairly.
bosses.action: Use current boss pages for up-to-date patterns.

sections.title: Build impact
paragraphs: Minion builds (Lich, Infernalist) that looked dead on 0.2.0 Day-1 became playable again after 0.2.0c, but should still be checked against current build pages rather than launch recordings.
Huntress spear levelling smoothed out as the corrected spear skills behaved as intended.
bullets: Check current build pages, not launch videos

sections.title: Day-1 vs post-0.2.0c
sections.oldText: Minions scaled so weakly that boss fights could take many minutes and felt like a mistake.
sections.newText: Per-gem-level corrections restored minion damage and life so the same builds cleared content at a reasonable pace.

items.question: Can I use a 0.2.0 Day-1 minion build?
answer: Not as-is. Wait for 0.2.0c at minimum, and prefer current build pages because minion balance moved again in 0.3 to 0.5.

items.question: Was 0.2.0c a buff or a nerf reversal?
answer: It reversed part of the 0.2.0 over-nerf to minions. Treat it as a correction, not a new power spike.
